rules.title: RSO/JCO Relocation Assistance Amounts (Chart A)
rules.requirement: Relocation assistance under the RSO or JCO, paid per unit, is $11,000 (less than 3 years) or $14,400 (3 or more years or low income) for eligible tenants, and $23,150 (less than 3 years) or $27,400 (3 or more years or low income) for qualified tenants.
rules.key_value: Eligible Tenant: $11,000 (less than 3 years) / $14,400 (3 or more years or low income); Qualified Tenant: $23,150 / $27,400
rules.coverage_text: Tenants of units under the RSO or JCO who are owed relocation assistance. Qualified tenants are 62 or older, handicapped or disabled, or have minor dependent children; all other tenants are eligible tenants. Low income means income of 80 percent or less of Area Median Income, regardless of length of tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Single family dwellings that are not lower income may be entitled to one month's equivalent of rent depending on various factors.
rules.citation: Relocation Assistance Bulletin, Chart A: RSO or JCO Amounts
rules.penalty: In an action by the landlord to recover possession of a rental unit, the tenant may raise as an affirmative defense the failure of the landlord to provide relocation assistance.

rules.title: Relocation for Single Family Dwellings Owned by Natural Persons
rules.requirement: For a single-family dwelling subject to the JCO owned by a natural person who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City, relocation is one month's rent in effect when the termination notice was served, as a payment or credit.
rules.key_value: one month’s rent that was in effect when the landlord served the written notice to terminate the tenancy
rules.coverage_text: Single-family dwellings subject to the JCO where the owner is a natural person (including one holding property in a trust or entity they control) who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.quoted_span: When the residential real property is a single-family dwelling subject to the JCO and the owner is a natural person, including natural persons who hold properties in a trust or registered legal entity controlled by that natural person, who owns no more than four dwelling units and a single-family home on a separate lot in the City of Los Angeles: one month’s rent that was in effect when the landlord served the written notice to terminate the tenancy, as either a monetary payment or credit.
rules.interaction_text: The Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 151.30(E) shall not apply.

rules.title: Relocation for Demolition for New Construction (RPO/HCA)
rules.requirement: Lower income households displaced for demolition of their units to be replaced with new construction must receive relocation payment consistent with benefits paid by public entities under Government Code Section 7260 et seq.; such tenants should receive at least the RSO or JCO amounts.
rules.coverage_text: Lower income households displaced for the purpose of demolition of their units where the owner will replace the units with new construction.
rules.citation: Government Code 66300.6(b)(4)(A); City Resident Protections Ordinance (RPO)
rules.quoted_span: The City’s Resident Protections Ordinance (RPO) and the State’s Housing Crisis Act (HCA) require that ONLY lower income households being displaced for the purpose of demolition of their units where the owner will replace the units with new construction must receive relocation payment consistent  to the relocation benefits required to be paid by public entities pursuant to Chapter 16 (commencing with Section 7260) of Division 7 of Title 1 (Government Code 66300.6(b)(4)(A)).
rules.interaction_text: Tenants being displaced for new construction should receive a minimum of the RSO or JCO amounts to be increased only if the HCA or RPO requir e it.

rules.title: Timing and Manner of Relocation Assistance Payments
rules.requirement: Relocation payments must be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction, split pro rata among multiple tenants, with the higher amount paid if more than one applies; the landlord may instead deposit funds in an escrow account within the 15-day period, with escrow payments made within three (3) working days of a request.
rules.key_value: within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction
rules.coverage_text: Landlords required to pay relocation assistance under the City Ordinances.
rules.penalty: In an action by the landlord to recover possession of a rental unit, the tenant may raise as an affirmative defense the failure of the landlord to provide relocation assistance.
rules.quoted_span: Payments shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction; however, the landlord may, at the landlord's sole discretion and at the landlord's cost, elect to pay the monetary relocation benefits through an escrow account. The monies must be placed in the escrow account within the required 15-day period.

rules.title: Option 3 Individualized Relocation: Initial RSO/JCO Payment
rules.requirement: Under Option 3, the owner must pay tenants the RSO or JCO relocation amounts within 15 days of filing the Notice of Intent to Withdraw or the Declaration of Intent to Evict, supplemented only if the owner's private consultant determines State law requires it.
rules.key_value: RSO or JCO relocation amounts within 15 days of filing
rules.coverage_text: Owners choosing Option 3 (individualized relocation) when filing a Notice of Intent to Withdraw or Declaration of Intent to Evict.
rules.citation: Relocation Assistance Bulletin, Option 3: Individualized Relocation
rules.quoted_span: In addition to complying with relocation amounts under Option 3, the owner is required to pay tenants the RSO or JCO relocation amounts within 15 days of filing the Notice of Intent to Withdraw or the Declaration of Intent to Evict, which will be supplemented only if the owner’s private consultant determines it is required under State law.
rules.interaction_text: Note, relocation payment above the RSO or JCO amount under Option 3 is regulated by state law.

rules.title: Relocation Offset for Accumulated Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may offset the tenant's accumulated rent against relocation assistance, except when the assistance is owed because a governmental order to vacate or comply for an unpermitted dwelling requires the termination.
rules.exemptions: No offset when the relocation assistance is owed because termination is required by a governmental agency order to vacate or comply issued for an unpermitted dwelling.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord may offset the tenant's accumulated rent against any relocation assistance, unless the relocation assistance is owed because a termination of tenancy is required by a governmental agency order to vacate or comply issued for an unpermitted dwelling.
